title: Research: full-grid reachability of actual dirty leaf prefixes
head: ff522ee7f46d09c9ff8b00bf6fd11d5995f5523f
body:
A reversible rounded-shear prefix cannot create a proper reachable lattice from arbitrary independent dirty input rows. This package proves the quantified full-bank surjectivity implication and binds it to the actual PR628 completed leaf interface: the increment is rounded separately, then added exactly; inverse execution negates the same rounded increment.

The new consequence addresses the affine-lattice precision handoff. Every prescribed intermediate dirty-bank state has a literal reverse-prefix preimage, so correlated affine-domain precision savings require a narrower entrance contract. An actual internal dirty-source cut reaches `(1/16,0)` from scratch `(5/16,1/16)`, excluding the predecessor's even-sum lattice. The illustrative rounded-linear reader is explicitly distinguished from the nonlinear PR628 leaf. The inherited standalone mixed-precision failure is credited, not claimed as new.

Package `research/dirty-prefix-full-grid/`, base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4; picker nonce `a7f327d4f87e29cb1c30d10d7fb83d81`, uniform-transfer-audit. Exact source SHA256/Git-blob checks precede all imports. Credit Chafik Boukhalfa PR628, Gareth Davidson's dirty-prefix caller, Ali Romman's kernel lineage, and woklerx's mixed-precision/affine-lattice results.

Registered optimized Python 3.12.14 replay PASS: 360 actual prefix preimages, 272 next-dirty-source cuts, ten finite nonlinear modular-bank controls and five excluded-premise countermodels. Git-free replay passes; actual receipt, source and inverse-sign corruptions fail. Reproduce with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/dirty-prefix-full-grid`. No hosted CI or full selected cold replay claimed.

The theorem requires all independent bank rows initially arbitrary on the same grid, fixed immutable entrance parameters, no aliasing/overflow/saturation, and total target-independent increments. It is only at completed leaf boundaries. Clean or bounded incoming domains, whole-sum rounding without a separate equivariance proof, and hidden state are excluded. No selected caller admission, physical compiler, precision saving or new kappa.

Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0, no independent human review. Status: completed and released for review.

Final overlap: 750 open PRs and 1216 Discussion records, complete pagination. Exact search matched only this local package; coverage is metadata, not every code diff. Parent AI proof review found no actionable issue.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
